name: CADSplat
aliases: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting Aided by CAD Models
definition: A framework that reconstructs photorealistic, geometrically accurate digital twins from sparse (< 15 views), wide-baseline posed images by regularizing 3D Gaussian Splatting with an explicit CAD shape prior.
summary: CADSplat reconstructs photorealistic digital twins from sparse images by regularizing 3D Gaussian Splatting with explicit CAD shape priors, avoiding the hallucinations of learned generative models.
